notes: *shall be ... as* is one unit on the comparative `kə`, which is the predicate of the verbless clause (rule 49), discontinuous around *all of them* under rule 25.
`kullām` divides as rule 19 directs: `kōl` keeps *all* and the suffix takes *of them*.
`lōʾ` alone takes *cannot*, no `yāḵōl` standing in the clause (rule 35).
